chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih, from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام say: “I do not like for a Muslim man to marry a woman if she would be a co-wife to his mother with someone other than his father.”

key_terms.ضَرَّةً: a co-wife; a woman sharing the same husband with another wife
key_terms.لِأُمِّهِ: for his mother / in relation to his mother

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked for a Muslim man to marry a woman who is his mother’s co-wife through another man?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys the Imam’s disapproval of a Muslim man marrying a woman who shares a marital bond with his mother through a man other than his father. It reflects concern for proper familial boundaries and the avoidance of morally and socially troubling relationships in marriage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4429 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih, from Zurara, who said:
I heard Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say: "I do not like for a Muslim man to marry a woman who would be a co-wife to his mother, with someone other than his father."
